method: Blind: candidates from scripts/cloud-sdk-label-candidates.mjs (an independent text search that imports no pipeline code), then one AI-assisted reading pass by four fresh-context labelling agents, one per batch of at most 100 candidates, each reading only its batch, the checkouts and the written rules, never Refit output. The runner spot-checked 12 labels against the code (all agreed). Not hand labelling and not second-labelled.
selection: Seeded sample (seededSample in scripts/ai-app-helpers.mjs, seed 20261022) per group: 12 aws-sdk-v2, 7 aws-sdk-v3, 6 azure. DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped (19,253 source files, over Refit 10,000-file scan limit, counted before any scan) was replaced by the next seeded aws-sdk-v3 pick, bbc/sqs-producer.

rules.aws-sdk-v2: new on an aws-sdk class that belongs to one service: a client (new AWS.S3()) or a class nested under one (AWS.DynamoDB.DocumentClient, AWS.S3.ManagedUpload); service is the v2 client name. Config, credential and endpoint classes are not clients.
rules.aws-sdk-v3: new on a client class exported by an @aws-sdk/client-* package (S3Client or aggregated S3); service is the package. Commands, exceptions, @aws-sdk/lib-* helpers and credential providers are not clients.
rules.azure-legacy: a line that loads a legacy Azure package (import, require, import =, import()); service is the package.
rules.scope: live JavaScript and TypeScript source only: test, spec, story, fixture and example paths, node_modules, dist, build, coverage, .next, .d.ts and .min.js are out of scope. Clients built in a file that names neither aws-sdk nor AWS. are outside the candidate net.
